deadline.value: No set deadline; applications accepted year-round, normally starting in September.
deadline.quote: There is no set deadline for applying to this program. Applications are accepted throughout the year with programs normally starting in September.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: Contacting a potential supervisor before applying is recommended.
supervisor.quote: Supervisor approval recommended before applying | We recommend that you contact the faculty that are doing research in an area that interests you before beginning a formal application.

funding.value: All eligible PhD students get a guaranteed minimum stipend of CAD 28,500 (2026/27) for 56 months, conditional on good academic standing and progress.
funding.quote: All eligible students will be guaranteed a stipend that may come from multiple funding sources such as research grants, scholarships, or teaching assistantships. | Ph.D. students will receive a minimum of $28,500 | Financial support is guaranteed for students in good academic standing for a period of 24 months for an M.Sc. student and 56 months for a Ph.D. student.

entry_route.value: PhD entry normally needs a master's (70%+); direct entry from a four-year BSc in chemistry is possible for exceptionally strong students (85%+ in the last two years) on department recommendation.
entry_route.quote: Master's degree, or equivalent, from a recognized university in an academic discipline relevant to the proposed field of study | With the recommendation of the unit, direct entry Ph.D. admission is available to exceptionally strong students | a cumulative weighted average of at least a 85% in the last two years of undergraduate study
